audience: busy Singapore office workers who make coffee in a shared pantry
viewer_problem: pantry coffee often tastes bitter and inconsistent
desired_outcome: viewers can remember and try three controllable fixes
approved_facts: Water that is too hot can contribute to unwanted bitterness.
Extending contact time can increase extraction and may intensify bitterness.
Changing one variable at a time makes it easier to identify the cause.
finish_condition: release package approved for a private dry run or routed to a named owner
